title: Gate stance vocabulary -- what a gate's failure DOES, declared once (ADR-006)
description: The one home of every enforcement stance a gate may stand in. A stance says what a failing gate does to `check`, never whether the gate runs: every gate that runs is shown, counted and named whatever its stance. `rank` orders the stances so a gate's FLOOR can be stated as a stance and compared without the interpreter knowing any stance by name. `unanswered` names the stance of a gate that neither its capability nor the host has answered for -- a declared state, never a guess. A new stance is a row here, never an edit to the interpreter.

unanswered.description: The stance of a gate nobody answered for. Must name a row below.

rank.description: Higher holds harder. A host may not declare a stance ranked below a gate's declared floor.

fails.description: Whether a failing gate in this stance fails `check`. Its failures are printed either way.
